title: Fail closed when the approval gate throws
goal: Treat approval UI/gate errors as explicit denial and failed observation so a goal does not remain active or accidentally execute without approval.
context: M6 awaits ApprovalGate.requestApproval with try; non-cancellation errors escape run() before denial/evaluation/state update. A broken or dismissed approval interface can therefore leave the goal active without an authoritative result.
forbidden_changes: Never treat a thrown approval error as approval.
Do not invoke the Skill or Module after approval failure.
Do not weaken policy or approval requirements.
acceptance_criteria: A non-cancellation ApprovalGate error becomes approved=false with a diagnostic reason.
The proposal is denied and receives a failed observation linked by actionID.
The goal reaches aborted state and emits no actionExecuted for the denied Skill.
Cancellation from the gate still propagates as cancellation.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Keep cancellation exceptional, map ordinary gate errors to explicit denial, and assert no execution plus authoritative aborted goal state.
